title: pm-dispatch: `.changeset` prose counts as an at-tier contract-review surface, so about 3 in 4 PRs spawn a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` subagent; narrow the isolated review to the contract faces
body:
Ruled: 5934170950 · letter A · 2026-10-01T15:03Z

Filing-gate category: **③ a maintainer-directed task, with the maintainer's ruling.** In `domain:ui` seat 2's session `session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42` (objectui), on 2026-10-01, the seat recommended narrowing this rule (option A below) and offered two routes. The maintainer answered, verbatim, 「立卡」, and then added the ruling: 「我已经同意了，不需要严格的规则」. That ruling refers to the seat's proposal, which the maintainer was shown verbatim: 「changeset 散文由席位在 ACCEPT 自核，不起 fable」.

Reader who acts: objectstack's **`domain:skills` seat**, implementing the ruling in a Tier S PR (`.claude/**`) to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` and every sentence that restates the rule (see "Where the rule lives"). Routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

Dedupe: the 1000 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2714, updated since 2026-09-27T23:02Z), were listed via REST and grepped locally for `changeset` within 80 characters of `contract review` / `at-tier` / `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` / `复核`. That gave 17 hits. Read by title, all 17 are seat posts or PR records that merely use both words, and none is about which surfaces owe the review. As a control, 8 bodies carry a `## Contract review` record, so the grep reaches review text.

## What happens today

`references/contract-review.md` 〈复核归属与资格(按面)〉 makes five surfaces owe an at-tier review record, and `.changeset` prose is one of them:

> 复核面 = 出货给用户或 agent 的五处:`content/docs/**`、`apps/docs/**`、CHANGELOG/`.changeset` 散文。
> 加已发布 schema(`packages/spec/src/**` 非测试)与 governed 规则文本(统一定义见 SKILL.md)。
> 五面皆不碰 ⇒ CI 加席位自读 ⛔ 不起第二个 agent;谁跑 = 派发席,达档者席内审。

`references/execution-duties.md` then forbids an off-tier seat from reviewing in-seat:

> 条款②自审资格按车道:spec 与 skills 席达档席内审;未达档 ⛔ 不自审,起隔离达档子代理。

Together, every PR with a releasing changeset owes an isolated `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` subagent whenever its seat is not spec or skills. The rule says 「按面 ⛔ 不按车道」, so this holds in every lane and both repos.

## Measured

- **Population (objectui).** Of the latest 40 merged non-release PRs (merged 2026-10-01 03:49Z–14:50Z, read via `GET /pulls?state=closed` plus each PR's `/files`), **30** add or modify a `.changeset/*.md` with a releasing frontmatter line (`'@pkg': patch|minor|major`). 6 carry an empty-frontmatter changeset only, and 4 carry none. Under the current text, 30 of 40 owe an isolated at-tier subagent.
- **Cost of one (objectui#11357 → PR objectui#11382).** The PR is 5 files, +479 / −1, of which 45 added source lines and 1 deleted line are code. `Clause-②: no`, and there is no spec or governed path. The isolated review ran **235,675 subagent tokens, 46 tool uses and 760 s**, and returned PASS (`5933224786` on objectui#11357).
- **What it found** beyond the seat's own ACCEPT (`5932883731`): one loose changeset sentence ("a key neither editor shows": the metadata editor's JSON source tab does show `requires`), and two PR-body misstatements it judged immaterial. That is all prose-level. The change landed before the record and is unaffected.

## Why this is the rule's defect, not the seat's

- **The maintainer narrowed this machinery before.** As quoted in PR #19694's 维护者速读, the maintainer said on 2026-09-18 「不需要 AI 不能自审契约改动 这种」, and on 2026-09-22 ruling B collapsed three review layers into one. The per-surface rule reintroduces a per-PR second agent through the prose face.
- **Different reversibility.**
  - Pending changeset prose stays editable until the release PR merges, and `changeset-claim-re-read` already asks the author to re-read a pending body their diff touches.
  - Published schema (`packages/spec/src/**`) and governed rule text are the surfaces where a wrong judgment is expensive and hard to reverse.
  - The rule gives them the same treatment.
- **Dilution.** When three in four PRs owe the at-tier review, it becomes a per-PR tax. Seats either spend a subagent slot on prose (which also counts against `batch`) or are tempted to rubber-stamp, and the contract faces get the same attention as a sentence.

## Ruling and what the PR implements

**Ruled: A.** The maintainer's words are quoted in the first paragraph.
- The isolated `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed only on the contract faces: `Clause-②: yes`, `packages/spec/src/**` (non-test), and governed rule text, plus Tier S `.claude/**` as today.
- `.changeset` / CHANGELOG prose moves to the dispatching seat's ACCEPT, at the seat's own tier: every sentence is judged against the diff, and the ACCEPT names the sentences it checked. No second agent is spawned for it.
- `content/docs/**` / `apps/docs/**` follow the same reasoning. The skills seat says in the PR whether they move with the prose, and the maintainer approves the PR as usual.
- Not taken: B (keep the five faces with in-seat prose review at any tier) and C (the status quo).
- The ruling applies from the moment it was given. `domain:ui` seat 2 already applies it to its in-flight `Clause-②: no` PRs; objectui#10993 batch 4 (`Clause-②: yes`) still gets its isolated at-tier review.

## 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**：实测 30/40 的 PR 带发布 changeset。单次隔离复审约 23.6 万 token，在本例只多抓出一句散文偏松。散文复核确有拉动（AI 写 changeset 易过度声称），但拉动的是「逐句对照 diff」这件事，不是「另起一个顶档 agent」。
- **项目长远合理性**：复核力度应随不可逆程度走。散文在发布 PR 合并前可改，契约面一旦发布难退。把两者放在同一档，长期结果是顶档复核被稀释成例行公事。A 让顶档复核只出现在它真正挡错的地方。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错**：A 不放松契约面，`Clause-②`、spec、受管面照旧走隔离顶档复核。散文仍须逐句核，只是改由派发席在 ACCEPT 里做并留痕，不会变成无人核。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求**：每个 PR 一个顶档子代理是无拉动的成本扩张，还占 `batch` 槽位、拖慢吞吐。A 是减零件不是加门禁。

已裁 **A**（维护者原话见首段）。长远读数领起：契约面守住，散文回到派发席。

## Where the rule lives (re-check before editing; anchors are content, not line numbers)

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`: `grep -n '复核面 = 出货给用户或 agent 的五处'`. Control: `grep -n '五面皆不碰'` must also hit.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`: `grep -n '条款②自审资格按车道'`.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`: `grep -n '条款②复核本席适用'` (it points at the per-surface rule).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` and `landing-operations.md`: any sentence that requires an at-tier record for changeset prose.

Read at objectstack `origin/main` `fbcc05f400`.
